notes: Three taḥwīl branches: the first two meet at جميعا عن عبيد الله, and the third writes عبيد الله, نافع, ابن عمر once after its own names, so those are the shared tail (occurrence 2 is the one before نافع)
وهو القطان and - واللفظ له - are editor glosses, left out; the verb glosses between dashes are left out too
أبي is the father of ابن نمير, a bare relation
